description: This file contains unit tests for the ThingPersistenceActor component of the Eclipse Ditto project. The tests verify creation, retrieval, modification, deletion, and recovery of 'things' in a persistent store, handling various versioning scenarios and error conditions. It uses Akka actors and testing tools to simulate actor behaviors, reboots, and message exchanges within the system.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the behaviors of the ThingPersistenceActor in various scenarios including creation, modification, deletion, recovery, and error handling within the Ditto system.

methods.name: unavailableExpectedIfPersistenceActorTerminates
methods.description: Tests that the system responds with a ThingUnavailableException when the persistence actor managing a thing terminates unexpectedly.

methods.name: tryToModifyFeaturePropertyAndReceiveCorrectErrorCode
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to modify a feature property that is inaccessible results in the correct error code being returned.

methods.name: tryToRetrieveThingWhichWasNotYetCreated
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving a thing that was never created results in a ThingNotAccessibleException.

methods.name: tryToCreateThingWithDifferentThingId
methods.description: Checks that commands sent to a persistence actor with a mismatched thing ID throw an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: createThingV2
methods.description: Tests creating a thing using the v2 API and confirms that the created thing matches expectations.

methods.name: modifyThingV1
methods.description: Tests modifying a thing with the v1 API and verifies correctness.

methods.name: modifyThingV2
methods.description: Tests modifying a thing with the v2 API and verifies correctness.

methods.name: doTestModifyThingKeepsOverwritesExistingFirstLevelFieldsWhenExplicitlySpecified

methods.name: modifyThingKeepsOverwritesExistingFirstLevelFieldsWhenExplicitlySpecified
methods.description: Test that first-level fields are correctly overwritten if specified during modification.

methods.name: modifyThingKeepsAlreadyExistingFirstLevelFieldsWhenNotExplicitlyOverwritten
methods.description: Validates that existing first-level fields are retained if not explicitly overwritten.

methods.name: doTestModifyThingKeepsAlreadyExistingFirstLevelFieldsWhenNotExplicitlyOverwritten
methods.description: Helper for testing retention of existing first-level fields when not explicitly changed.

methods.name: modifyAttributeSoThatThingGetsTooLarge
methods.description: Tests that modifications leading to an attribute size exceeding limits raise a ThingTooLargeException.

methods.name: retrieveThingV2
methods.description: Tests retrieving a thing with the v2 API and confirms the returned data matches expectations.

methods.name: retrieveThingsWithoutThingIdOfActor
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving multiple things across different IDs works only if the IDs belong to the actor.

methods.name: deleteThingV1
methods.description: Tests deletion of a thing with the v1 API.

methods.name: deleteThingV2
methods.description: Tests deletion of a thing with the v2 API.

methods.name: deleteAndRecreateThingWithMinimumData
methods.description: Verifies that after deletion and re-creation, the minimal data is preserved and the previous data is cleared.

methods.name: modifyFeatures

methods.name: modifyAttributes

methods.name: modifyAttribute

methods.name: retrieveAttribute

methods.name: deleteAttribute

methods.name: recoverThingDeleted

methods.name: recoverAclModified

methods.name: recoverAclEntryModified

methods.name: recoverAclEntryDeleted
methods.description: Verifies recovery of ACL entry deletions.

methods.name: ensureSequenceNumberCorrectness
methods.description: Ensures the sequence number of a thing remains correct after creation and modification.

methods.name: ensureSequenceNumberCorrectnessAfterRecovery
methods.description: Ensures sequence numbers are consistent after actor recovery.
